title: Residential Systems & Shop Safety
markdown:
# RCS Day 1 - Residential Systems & Shop Safety

CTS Cohort 6 | D09 / RCS01 | Monday, July 20, 2026

## Core rule
A professional does not guess. A professional checks, protects, and verifies.

## Theme
Residential construction is a set of connected systems: structure, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, envelope, and finish.

## Learning targets
- Identify major residential building systems.
- Select task-appropriate PPE.
- Explain stop-work authority and tool accountability.
- Identify common power tools and primary hazards.
- Assemble, inspect, leak test, troubleshoot, and document a rolling sink/P-trap module.

## Daily flow
- 10:00-10:10: Arrival + setup - Students get notebooks, pencils, quiz sheet. Instructor sets out PPE and rolling sink modules but keeps water off.
- 10:10-10:20: Safety reset + day goal - Frame RCS as residential systems plus professional habits. Tool use is earned by demonstrated control.
- 10:20-10:35: Morning quiz - Individual, quiet. Use as a teaching check, not a trap.
- 10:35-10:50: Quiz review - Correct together. Ask students to explain why a safety choice matters.
- 10:50-11:15: Slides part 1 - RCS overview, building systems, final wall capstone preview.
- 11:15-11:45: Safety + PPE demo - PPE selection, stop-work authority, tool accountability.
- 11:45-12:05: Power tool intro - Drill/driver, circular saw, miter saw, jigsaw, oscillating tool. Demonstration only unless students are cleared.
- 12:05-12:30: Whiteboard challenge - Map a simple sink system: supply -> shutoff -> faucet -> sink -> drain -> P-trap -> outlet.
- 12:30-1:00: Lunch / reset - No unsupervised tool or water work during lunch.
- 1:00-1:15: Lab demo - Show parts, washer orientation, hand-tight assembly, leak-test setup, and documentation expectation.
- 1:15-2:15: Rolling sink lab - Teams inventory, assemble, inspect, leak test, correct, and document.
- 2:15-2:35: Troubleshooting + retest - Groups diagnose leaks or alignment problems, then retest.
- 2:35-2:50: Cleanup + evidence - Water off, station dry, parts counted, tools returned, verification log completed.
- 2:50-3:00: Exit ticket + dismissal - Students answer four prompts and preview Day 2 measurement/framing.
